title: Velo Client 0.9.3
summary: A quick fix update: Velo+ Addons install reliably again, the launcher tells you exactly why if they can't, Fabric API is always the newest build, and a startup crash with the Addons is gone.

blocks.text: 0.9.3 fixes the problems some of you had right after 0.9.2.

items: **Velo+ Addons install again** - *Add to this profile* in the Mods tab works for every member.
**No more silent failures** - if the Addons can't be added, the card now says why (offline, not signed in, no build for that Minecraft version yet).
**Always the newest Fabric API** - the launcher now installs the latest Fabric API for your Minecraft version, so mods that need a recent one just work.
**Startup crash fixed** - the game no longer crashes while loading with the Addons installed.
